mls.text: Unable to login to mobile app
User reporting login failures on iOS app version 2.3.1
Customer reports that they cannot login to the mobile app. Error message displayed: 'Invalid credentials'. User confirmed password is correct and can login via web browser.
Customer requesting dark mode option for better nighttime viewing
Customer would like dark mode support in the application. They mention eye strain during evening use and note that competitors offer this feature.
Feature has been added to product roadmap for Q2 2024 release.
Multiple users reporting payment failures during checkout process
Several customers reported payment processing errors when attempting to complete purchases. Error code: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT. Affects credit card transactions only.
Issue identified as timeout configuration in payment gateway. Updated timeout settings from 5s to 30s. Deployed fix and verified with test transactions.
